proceso.label: Our methodology
proceso.step1_body: What is the suit for? What do you want to convey? Everything begins with understanding the moment and the person.
proceso.step2_body: Every element we choose, lapel, shoulder, fabric, color — communicates something. We do it consciously and precisely.
proceso.step3_body: You won't see a suit. You'll see an elevated version of yourself. That is the difference between clothing and identity.

items.quote: Working with Manuel for my suit was a pleasure every step of the way. I was clear that for my wedding I wanted something extra special, a regular suit would not suffice, what I really wanted was a tailcoat.
items.name: Lucas Fox

items.quote: Suit fits like a glove. I don't feel like I'm wearing a suit, I feel like I'm wearing a track suit. Wonderful service and a fair price for something I will own for decades and pass down to my sons.
items.name: Kristófer Alex Guðmundsson

items.quote: I am very happy with a suit, which was made by Manuel. When I tried it on — I felt a different person. It is elegant, perfect fit and just timeless. I am very grateful to Evelina for helping me with choosing a fabric colour and pattern.
items.name: Tamara Smerechynska

items.quote: I'm a young man and recently had my first experience with artisan tailoring at Sastrería Manuel Fernández — and it couldn't have been better. From the very first style consultation, I felt very close and professional accompaniment. The team guided me through every detail: fabrics, cut, colours... always with very good taste and attention to what really suited me and the occasion. The service was impeccable, very careful and personalised, something hard to find nowadays. Throughout the whole process I felt they were creating something unique for me — not just a suit, but a piece with identity. The final result exceeded my expectations. I chose this suit for my graduation and, without a doubt, it will be the first of many bespoke pieces. I recommend 100% to anyone who values elegance, quality and true artisan service.
items.name: Manuel Vale

historia.label: The Story
historia.title: A Lifelong Vocation
historia.p1: Sastrería Manuel Fernández has dressed, throughout its history, prominent personalities such as members of the Royal Family, politicians, elite athletes and figures from the world of entertainment and television, also participating in major film and theatre productions.
historia.p2: Manuel absorbed not only the technique, the English cut, the handmade canvas, the lapel that falls on its own — but also the philosophy: that every client deserves a unique garment, built from scratch.
historia.p3: Years later, nothing has changed. The same respect for the cloth, the same patience with the pattern, the same honest conversation before a single measurement is taken. Each suit is unique, unrepeatable, handmade.

maestro.label: The Master
maestro.quote: A suit is not finished when the last stitch is sewn. It is finished when the person wearing it recognises in it a better version of themselves.
maestro.p1: Manuel Fernández has more than 40 years of experience in artisan tailoring, dedicated to the design and making of all types of bespoke garments. Specialised in ceremonial attire, his style is distinguished by a precise, personal and recognisable cut, where classic elegance is interpreted with its own character.
maestro.p2: His work reflects a savoir-faire inherited and perfected throughout a lifetime, combined with a contemporary outlook that projects tailoring towards the future. Each garment is born from a deep knowledge of the craft, proportion and detail, achieving unique pieces that balance tradition, innovation and excellence.

evelyn.label: The Workshop
evelyn.p1: Evelyn Fernández, trained in Advertising at the Complutense University of Madrid and specialised in the luxury universe through the Luxury Direction and Strategic Management programme at IE Business School, has developed her career between Madrid and Paris in projects linked to fashion, branding and the premium client.
evelyn.p2: With an international vision and a marked aesthetic sensitivity, she has driven different business initiatives within the lifestyle and luxury sector, consolidating an approach focused on exclusivity, experience and detail.
evelyn.p3: She currently leads Sastrería Manuel Fernández, positioning it as a benchmark in high-level artisan tailoring, aimed at a demanding and global clientele, with service in Spanish, English and French.

espacio.title: Where the Suit is Born
espacio.description: A private workshop in Madrid where every visit is an experience as carefully considered as the garment created within it.
espacio.subtitle: Tailoring
espacio.body: You will discover a place full of tradition, elegance, distinction and innovation. Here, we will make you discover the passion of bespoke dressing.

filosofia.label: The Philosophy
filosofia.p1: At Sastrería Manuel Fernández, the process begins with questions, not measuring tape. We want to understand who you are, what moment you are living, what you want to communicate to the world.
filosofia.p2: The result is never just a suit. It is a tool of identity. A silent declaration. The most authentic version of yourself, sewn by hand.
